steps.name: publish
argv:
# EVERY FILE IS NAMED IN FULL, not matched by a glob. Two reasons and both
# are scars. A glob that misses publishes nothing while returning a code
# that reads like a fetch failure; and box_enqueue.output_path_problems
# refuses a spec whose declared artifacts are never named by any step,
# which a wildcard defeats. Missing ONE file is a FAIL of the job.
import hashlib, os, shutil
from_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/ep2-b14-mac-plate-0818-out"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b14-mac-plate-0818"
NAMES = [
    "14-the-defense-mac-plate-r1s1.png",
    "14-the-defense-mac-plate-r1s1.yaml",
    "14-the-defense-mac-plate-r1s2.png",
    "14-the-defense-mac-plate-r1s2.yaml",
    "14-the-defense-mac-plate-r1s3.png",
    "14-the-defense-mac-plate-r1s3.yaml",
]
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
lines = []
for name in NAMES:
    f = os.path.join(from_dir, name)
    if not os.path.isfile(f):
        raise SystemExit("!! missing %s -- refusing to call the job clean." % f)
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    with open(os.path.join(dst, name), "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + name)
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b14-mac-plate-0818.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(sorted(lines)) + "\n")
print("published", len(lines), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(lines) == len(NAMES) else 1)
